book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، لندن كلها كانت بتحكي عن الرهان.
sentences.en: The next day, all London was talking about the wager.
The papers wrote about it, and people argued.
Some said: he can.
And some said: madman.

sentences.ar: وصاروا يراهنوا على فوغ، زي ما بيراهنوا على حصان.
sentences.en: And they began betting on Fogg, as one bets on a horse.
And after a week, everyone was against Fogg.
A hundred to one.
And then two hundred.

sentences.ar: إلا رجل واحد، عجوز مشلول، راهن خمسة آلاف على فوغ.
sentences.en: Except one man, an old paralytic, who bet five thousand on Fogg.

sentences.ar: وبعد أسبوع، إجا خبر من سكوتلانديارد.
sentences.en: And after a week, news came from Scotland Yard.

sentences.ar: برقية من السويس، من مفتش اسمه فيكس.
sentences.en: A telegram from Suez, from a detective named Fix.

sentences.ar: مكتوب فيها: أنا ماشي ورا حرامي البنك.
sentences.en: It said: I am following the bank robber.
Phileas Fogg.
Send an arrest warrant to Bombay.
And London was turned upside down.
Fogg a thief?
The gentleman?
And they said: of course.
That is why he left so fast.
The wager an excuse, and the aim escape.
And they searched his life.

sentences.ar: ما حدا بيعرف من وين إجا.
sentences.en: No one knew where he came from.

sentences.ar: وما حدا بيعرف من وين مصاريه.
sentences.en: And no one knew where his money came from.
And he looked like the description of the thief.
And his picture was in the papers.
And even his friends at the club began to doubt.

sentences.ar: قال المهندس: لعب معنا ورق سنين.
sentences.en: The engineer said: he played cards with us for years.
Impossible.

sentences.ar: وقال مدير البنك: أحسن حرامي هو اللي ما بتشك فيه.
sentences.en: And the bank director said: the best thief is the one you never suspect.
And meanwhile, Fogg was at sea.

sentences.ar: على باخرة اسمها المونغوليا، بين إيطاليا ومصر.
sentences.en: On a steamer named the Mongolia, between Italy and Egypt.
Eating, sleeping, playing cards.
He did not look at the sea once.
And Passepartout looked at it for him.

sentences.ar: وكل يوم يسأل: وينا اليوم يا سيدي؟
sentences.en: And every day asked: where are we today, sir?
And Fogg would say: on time.
